metadata.name: tagebuch-thailand
metadata.description: A shared travel journal for two: daily curated suggestions, tap-to-stamp activities, and auto-generated end-of-day postcards, all synced live between both travelers
metadata.author: Calimero

flow: Open the app each morning to see today's stop and suggestions
Stamp activities together throughout the day
Review the day and generate a postcard in the evening
Browse the shared gallery of every postcard from the trip
